entities.summary: Saint Juvenal of Narni (juvenal-of-narni) was a pivotal figure in the early Christian Church, serving as the first Bishop of Narni in Umbria, Italy, from approximately 304 to 376 AD. Juvenal was born in Africa, possibly in the region of modern-day Tunisia, and was ordained by Pope Damasus I, who played a crucial role in the formation of the Western Christian Church. Juvenal's significance lies in his role as a bridge between the early Christian community and the establishment of the Catholic Church in Italy, as well as his efforts to spread Christianity throughout the region.
